_comment: The idea-archive transition contract. This is the ONLY executable clause of the retired specs/markdown-retirement-policy.json: that file was 223 lines of which these 19 were the only ones any gate parsed, the other 204 being migration phases that had gone overdue-needs-replan with no owner. The clause now lives beside the gate that reads it (ci/facade/cross-artifact-agreement), so the contract and its enforcement move together. Shape is unchanged on purpose -- parse_idea_archive_policy requires retention_rules.idea_archive with exactly policy_version, mode and transition, so this is a rehome and not a rewrite.
